name: 共生拖行
description: 弹射物：选择同一行或同一列的方向，将路径上第一名敌人拉至毒液身前一格。（若身前格子无法放置则无效）
targetText: 同一行或同一列的1个方向
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var targetPos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPos || targetPos.needsTargetSelection) return targetPos; if (caster.x == null || caster.y == null) return { success: false, message: '毒液当前不在战场上' }; var dx = targetPos.x - caster.x; var dy = targetPos.y - caster.y; if ((dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return { success: false, message: '必须选择与毒液在同一行或同一列的方向' }; var direction = { x: dx === 0 ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1), y: dy === 0 ? 0 : (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1) }; var events = traceProjectile({ x: caster.x, y: caster.y }, direction, { excludePieceId: caster.instanceId }); var hit = null; var distance = 0; for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) { var event = events[i]; if (event.type === 'piece') { if (event.piece.ownerPlayerId === caster.ownerPlayerId) return { success: true, message: '共生拖行被路径上的友方角色阻挡' }; hit = event.piece; distance = event.distance; break; } if (event.type === 'terrain' && event.blocksProjectile) return { success: true, message: '共生拖行被地形阻挡' }; } if (!hit) return { success: true, message: '路径上没有可拖行的敌人' }; if (distance <= 1) return { success: true, message: '相邻敌人不能成为共生拖行的目标' }; var landing = { x: caster.x + direction.x, y: caster.y + direction.y }; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === landing.x && item.y === landing.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: true, message: '毒液正前方不是合法落点' }; var occupied = battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.instanceId !== caster.instanceId && piece.instanceId !== hit.instanceId && piece.x === landing.x && piece.y === landing.y; }); if (occupied) return { success: true, message: '毒液正前方已被占用' }; hit.x = landing.x; hit.y = landing.y; if (!hit.statusTags) hit.statusTags = []; var tag = hit.statusTags.find(function(item) { return item.type === 'venom-corrosion-immobile' && item.sourceId === caster.instanceId; }); if (tag) { tag.currentDuration = 1; tag.remainingDuration = 1; } else { addStatusEffectById(hit.instanceId, { id: 'venom-corrosion-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + hit.instanceId, name: '腐蚀', type: 'venom-corrosion-immobile', currentDuration: 1, remainingDuration: 1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: caster.instanceId, relatedRules: ['rule-venom-corrosion-immobile'] }); addRuleById(hit.instanceId, 'rule-venom-corrosion-immobile'); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动共生拖行，将' + hit.name + '拉到身前并使其定身1回合' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '沿同一行或同一列捕获路径上的第1名敌人并拉到身前，不造成伤害。', expectedValues: {} }; }
